geometry: Obstacle-free interior; one-voxel shell on all six faces is native Outlet=2; interior Free=0. No floor/shoreline/building geometry.
boundary_rule: All six simulation faces; never an ROI edge and never a mean-wind-selected side.
mass_proxy_definition: For each native isotropic Gaussian, use products of normal CDF differences to integrate the box inside the effective outlet planes and its 1 m inset. Sum using equal conserved filament moles. Band fraction=(M_effective_box-M_inset_box)/M_effective_box. Also report (M_full_Gaussians-M_effective_box)/M_full_Gaussians. The untruncated Gaussian integral is a conservative analytic support diagnostic, not a measurement of deleted mass. The stronger 3sigma support-margin and zero-deletion gates are both mandatory.
assessment_frames: All native saved records over 0..140 s for no-deletion and 3sigma margin; the 51 aligned 20..120 s frames for mean/q95 band fractions. Instrument count/exception events at every tick or demonstrate the native fixed-release/outlet-control-flow invariant.
roi_policy: Native route observations and source candidates remain inside ROI. ROI column footprint integrates the full simulated vertical column; record whole-domain footprint as secondary. Leaving ROI is a sensing consequence, not physical-domain truncation.
failure: M0_BASE_SUPPORT_HOLD, not scientific STOP. No automatic enlargement, source relocation, window shortening or favorable-realization selection. A new build revision needs review and a new freeze before additional runs.
static_guard_claim: Geometric guard distances are established; stochastic plume containment has not been simulated or guaranteed. Native periodic Gaussian-table noise makes an IID diffusion-envelope proof inappropriate.
intervention_support_rule: All 32 intervention runs must pass the SAME all-six-face support, no-deletion and centroid rules as the eight baselines. A failed intervention support gate invalidates causal scoring and produces HOLD, not a scientific STOP.
